digest.component_or_area: completion evidence banking and verdict assembly
propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE incorrectly banks met=false (evidence absence) as evidence-of-absence (refutation), causing false FAIL verdicts on criteria where evidence exists but was not reached within the search window

The banking layer must distinguish three evidence outcomes (met, refuted, insufficient) and carry exhaustion state via an optional framework-only evidence_sufficient:false marker alongside met=false, preserved on re-harvest but replaced by genuine refutations

The model-facing record tool remains bool-only; only the framework's bounded fallback banks the marker via a new record_insufficient path, ensuring tool met=false signals positive refutation not exhaustion
Verdict rendering and close-gate refusal must report insufficient-evidence remediation (not unmet-criteria guidance) when the marker is present, while maintaining fail-closed gate semantics
Schema, validation, finalizer re-stamp, sidecar payload, and reconciliation must all support marker round-trip without altering bool-based gates or core verdict semantics
